answer: Physical Embodiment Ledger. Each identity must submit a continuous sensor stream (accelerometer, gyroscope, ambient light) from a device that cannot be simulated while stationary in a rack; a zephyr of natural vibration variance is required in every window. Validation is delta-scored: readings must fall within a narrow drift band across sessions. Registered hardware is sealed with a copper tamper mesh that zeroes its key on intrusion. An attacker pays for one physical device, power, and secure housing per identity, plus replacement cost on any detected spoof.
